_note: micro:bit V2 (nRF52833). Confirmed as V2 for the simulator: V2 adds touch logo, speaker, microphone. Edge connector shows the 5 large pads accessible without a breakout board. P0/P1/P2 support GPIO, ADC, and PWM (nRF52833 PWM is software-routable to any pin). P0 and P2 also support capacitive touch on V2. Small edge-connector pins require a breakout board (see microbit_breakout).
